fundamentals.title: AI Safety Fundamentals
fundamentals.tagline: First principles. Drop in any week.
fundamentals.whoItSuits: For newcomers. Taught so you can drop in for any theme, no background needed.
fundamentals.summary: A weekly series on risks, technical safety and governance, taught so newcomers can drop in. Three editions in Utrecht have reached more than 100 students, researchers, engineers and public-sector people.
outline: Introduction: capabilities, risks, and solution families
Risks and incidents: social harms, misuse, loss of control
Technical AI Safety: oversight, evaluations, interpretability
Regulation and governance: EU AI Act, audits, GPAI duties
Why safety is hard: incentives, funding gaps, race dynamics
Pathways: thesis, fellowship, then a full-time role

cities.utrecht: Weekly, modular. Drop in for any theme. ~60 min.

technical.title: Technical Alignment
technical.whoItSuits: For people who want to build: interpretability, RLHF, and the alignment pipeline, hands-on.
technical.summary: Each chapter runs a technical track, with a different curriculum. Utrecht covers evaluations, embodied AI and agent security, with assignments from ARENA. Groningen and Amsterdam use BlueDot.
outline: Implementing and evaluating AI safety evaluations

cities.utrecht: Technical AI Safety. 4 weeks, 1.5-hour lectures, Saturday workshops. Programming needed.
cities.groningen: BlueDot Technical AI Safety. 6 weeks, on-site, application-based.
cities.amsterdam: BlueDot Technical AI Safety. 6 weeks, on-site, application-based.

policy.title: Governance & Policy
policy.tagline: BlueDot or SAIN Utrecht, by city.
policy.whoItSuits: For people headed toward policy: the EU AI Act, audits, and Dutch implementation.
policy.summary: Amsterdam and Groningen run BlueDot Frontier AI Governance, and Groningen adds materials on the EU perspective. Utrecht runs a four-week AI Governance course that also looks at where Europe and other middle powers fit. Facilitators include researchers, risk consultants, and public-sector people.
outline: The EU AI Act: duties across the lifecycle
Risk management: NIST and frontier evaluation
Case studies: accidents, misuse, institutional lag
Pathways: policy fellowships, ministries, standards bodies

cities.utrecht: AI Governance. 4 weeks, 1.5-hour lectures. No background needed.
cities.groningen: BlueDot Frontier AI Governance, with EU materials. On-site, application-based.
cities.amsterdam: BlueDot Frontier AI Governance. On-site, application-based.

cadence.heading: How cohorts run
cadence.intro: Not sure which chapter fits? Each city’s page lists its own programmes in detail.
items: Cohorts run per chapter. Groningen and Amsterdam teach in six-week blocks, and Groningen runs three to four cohorts a year. Utrecht's Technical AI Safety and AI Governance blocks run four weeks.
The six-week courses pair weekly readings with an on-site discussion session.
AI Safety Fundamentals in Utrecht is weekly and modular. Drop in for any theme, about 60 minutes.
Some programmes are application-based and close per cohort. The Amsterdam BlueDot tracks are an example.
One form covers participants and facilitators. Facilitator deadlines close a few days earlier.
